description: Two managers: the Python project (pyproject.toml and uv.lock) and the SHA-pinned GitHub Actions. The shared preset's 14-day wait matches uv's exclude-newer in pyproject.toml.

lockFileMaintenance.description: uv enforces the 14-day wait on a refresh (exclude-newer in pyproject.toml), so refreshes are on.

packageRules.description: A library declares the lowest versions it supports, and CI tests those floors (the lowest job). Raising a floor is a deliberate change, so Renovate moves uv.lock only and leaves pyproject.toml's ranges alone.
